entries.name: AccessExpectation
entries.meaning: One exact system-instance expectation lineage owns predecessor/successor competition, independent approval and same-line exceptions. Different lines may coexist, including different policies on one system. No cross-line exclusion governor or ban is implied; a future ban requires a separately reviewed precise predicate. Tenant realm and immutable system-instance binding plus root expectation-line identity. The first proposal roots the line; every successor shares the exact approved predecessor line conflict key. An expectation is scoped to one system instance and carries one rule kind: forbidden_principal_kind (names only a principal kind), privileged_entitlement or requires_expiry, with parameters validated per kind, a named approver, and a monotonically increasing version on its line. Any other rule kind is refused. Independent proposer/reviewer or exact waiver; exception references approved expectation and future expiry.

entries.name: ControlEvaluation
entries.meaning: One evaluation including steps, conclusions, review and deviation dispositions. A retest is a new evaluationId using this same type and an immutable predecessor evaluation/version proof. Tenant-scoped tenant / evaluationId; `EvaluationId` on `StartControlEvaluation` is the caller-supplied immutable creation identity (exact immutable creation retry) so an exact retry resolves the original result and a different id is a different record; later mutations use CommandId bound to this identity and the expected revision. Each step records an assertion (design, implementation, evidence_sufficiency), a method (inquiry, inspection, observation, reperformance), typed inspected items and an expected condition. A step result is met, not_met or not_tested with a rationale; per-assertion and overall results are effective, effective_with_exceptions, ineffective or not_tested, and overall effective requires every step of every assertion met. A not_met step requires a deviation classified minor or material: a material deviation makes the result ineffective, creates or links a Finding with a corrective action and requires a retest (a new evaluation naming the deviation); a minor deviation needs a disposition of corrected or accepted_with_waiver and the result is at best effective_with_exceptions. A deviation never closes because a later evaluation passed; closure requires an explicit retest link, and the deviation keeps its procedure, exact inputs, tester and original result. Material deviation source proof, immutable procedure version, reviewer independence, and explicit minor-deviation disposition.

entries.name: RiskEvaluation
entries.meaning: Assessment phases follow inherent/current method; residual requires treatment and mitigate admission proof; acceptance must name current residual and accept treatment, satisfy score/appetite/authority/expiry, and be independent from assessor/owner unless exactly waived. An assessment records inherent or residual phase, likelihood 1 to 5 and impact 1 to 5 against a specific method version, with the score derived as likelihood times impact and never supplied. A treatment is one of mitigate, accept, transfer or avoid and carries a rationale. A residual score above the method's appetite threshold is above appetite, and while the threshold is null every risk is treated as above appetite; the Compliance Lead may accept only at or below a non-null threshold and anything else requires an executive approver. Acceptance expiry must be after acceptance and no later than 12 months after it, after which the risk returns to reassessment, and acceptance does not close findings or count as remediation. An externally sourced IncidentReference (source ID, occurrence time, summary, provenance) may trigger reassessment but never rewrites earlier risk history.
